text: Leah: Quick design review — model catalog compare view. Not urgent but want input on filters + badges + pin UX. Sharing a couple quick notes and a tiny mock. Jamal: Saw the branch. Filter chips are losing focus ring in keyboard nav on chromium. :eyes: small CSS regression? Sacha: Important — badges can't rely on color alone. Use an icon + textual label (e.g. "⚡ Fast") and add aria-label="performance: fast (p90 1.2s)". Also request contrast >= 3:1 for the medium badge background. Marie: Microcopy nit: 'Pin' is ambiguous in the compare header. Can we change 'Pin' -> 'Pin model version' in the button and tooltip: 'Pin model version — lock this row to this exact model version for comparisons and rollouts.' Ethan: Proposed layout: collapsible left filter rail -> default collapsed on small viewports; filters as a searchable dropdown of categories. Compare table: sticky header + column resize grips; when many models, show a horizontal overflow indicator and a 'Show all columns' CTA. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/compare-mock Samir: For backend, pinning should set a route param so links are sharable. Also for compare perf badges, can we compute p90 server-side and cache for 5m? reduces noise. Leah: UX question — should 'Pinned' rows float to the top? I worry about visual jank when toggling. Maybe a subtle 'pinned' stripe and a filter to view only pinned. Sacha: Accessibility: keyboard order must follow visual order (including floating pinned rows). Ensure aria-live updates only for metric changes and provide a 'last updated' timestamp in the header. Jamal: I'll push a tiny patch: add :focus-visible ring, update badge markup to include perf: fast, and leave a TODO for server-side caching. deploy-bot: Preview deployed at https://staging.redwood.infer/compare/1745604321 — comment if anything looks off :rocket: Leah: Thanks team. Let's collect final small copy & a11y fixes by EOD and then ship the staging preview to design review tomorrow morning. :+1:
